Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ajay - 29 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Sunita - 57 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Pallavi - 29 years, friend
Look: green saree

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The temple - stone pillars, a big bell
4. The bazaar - fruit stalls, a crowd

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ajay stands by the road. Sunita and Pallavi stand near him.]

Ajay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ajay rides his motorbike to the market.]

Sunita: "Yes, all right."

[Ajay starts his scooter and rides off.]

Ajay: "How beautiful!"

[Ajay gets out of the car.]

Ajay: "Pallavi, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Ajay: "Let's begin."

[Ajay laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Ajay: "Yes, of course."

[Ajay jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Ajay (laughing): "This is amazing!"

Scene 3: The temple - Day

[Ajay stands in the temple. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "So, here we are!"

[Ajay rings the temple bell.]

Ajay (happily): "Yes, all right."

[Ajay folds his hands and prays.]

Ajay (happily): "One more time!"

[Ajay kneels before the idol.]

Sunita (happily): "One more time!"

Scene 4: The bazaar - Day

[Ajay stands in the bazaar. Sunita stands near him.]

Ajay: "Mom, look over here."

[Ajay haggles with the shopkeeper.]

Ajay: "That was fun!"

[Ajay pays the fruit seller.]

Sunita: "Oh wow!"

[Ajay walks through the crowded bazaar.]

Ajay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
